statement: Each swap clause in the proof body carries an allowance on both tokens, sized to what remains (a Left maker's give lowers Left's delta, its want raises it; a Right maker's the inverse), or the finalize would revert (R-SWAP-ONCHAIN). The clause follows the payment clauses, swap clauses in slot order, deltaIndex = token position, and shrinks with every fill.
